title: Most Champions League finals
brief: Name the ten clubs that have played in the most Champions League finals since 1993. Four clubs tie on three finals for the last three places.

notes.Dortmund: Dortmund played 3 finals: won 1997, lost 2013 and 2024.
notes.Chelsea: Chelsea played 3 finals: lost 2008, won 2012 and 2021.
notes.Inter: Inter played 3 finals: won 2010, lost 2023 and 2025.
notes.PSG: PSG played 3 finals: lost 2020, won 2025 and 2026.
notes.Ajax: Ajax played 2 finals (won 1995, lost 1996), just outside.
notes.Valencia: Valencia played 2 finals (lost 2000 and 2001), just outside.
notes.Arsenal: Arsenal played 2 finals (lost 2006 and 2026), just outside.
notes.Atletico Madrid: Atletico Madrid played 2 finals (lost 2014 and 2016), just outside.
notes.Man City: Man City played 2 finals (lost 2021, won 2023), just outside.

sources: index.html UCL_W and UCL_R (the game's finals list)
checks: Counted from the game's UCL_W and UCL_R arrays for 1993 to 2026, then counted again from the two finalists of all 34 Transfermarkt final match reports; both counts agree club for club.
